dn31:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
dn31:1.3: tena kho pana samayena sigālako gahapatiputto kālasseva vuṭṭhāya rājagahā nikkhamitvā allavattho allakeso pañjaliko puthuddisā namassati,
dn31:1.4: puratthimaṃ disaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pacchimaṃ disaṃ uttaraṃ disaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ disaṃ uparimaṃ disaṃ.
dn31:2.1: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
dn31:2.2: addasā kho bhagavā sigālakaṃ gahapatiputtaṃ kālasseva vuṭṭhāya rājagahā nikkhamitvā allavatthaṃ allakesaṃ pañjalikaṃ puthuddisā namassantaṃ,
dn31:2.3: puratthimaṃ disaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pacchimaṃ disaṃ uttaraṃ disaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ disaṃ uparimaṃ disaṃ.
dn31:2.5: kinnu kho tvaṃ gahapatiputta kālasseva uṭṭhāya rājagahā nikkhamitvā allavattho allakeso pañjaliko puthuddisā namassasi,
dn31:2.6: puratthimaṃ disaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ pacchimaṃ disaṃ uttaraṃ disaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ disaṃ uparimaṃ disanti?”
dn31:2.7: “pitā maṃ bhante, kālaṃ karonto evaṃ avaca:
dn31:2.9: so kho ahaṃ bhante pitu vacanaṃ sakkaronto garukaronto mānento pūjento kālasseva vuṭṭhāya rājagahā nikkhamitvā allavattho allakeso pañjaliko puthuddisā namassāmi,
dn31:2.12: “na kho gahapatiputta, ariyassa vinaye evaṃ chaddisā namassitabbā”ti.
dn31:2.13: “yathā kathaṃ pana bhante, ariyassa vinaye chaddisā namassitabbā?
dn31:2.14: sādhu me bhante bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā ariyassa vinaye chadidisā namassitabbā”ti.
dn31:2.15: chaddisā tena hi gahapatiputta, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi, bhāsissāmī’ti.
dn31:2.16: ‘evaṃ bhante’ti kho sigālo gahapatiputto bhagavato paccassosi.
dn31:3.1: “yato kho gahapatiputta, ariyasāvakassa cattāro kammakilesā pahīṇā honti, catūhi ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karoti, cha ca bhogānaṃ apāyamukhāni na sevati, so evaṃ cuddasapāpakāpagato, chaddisāpaṭicchādī,
dn31:3.2: ubhayalokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti, tassa ayaṃ ceva loko āraddho hoti paro ca loko.
dn31:3.3: so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati.
dn31:3.6: pāṇātipāto kho gahapatiputta kammakileso, adinnādānaṃ kammakileso, kāmesu micchācāro kammakileso, musāvādo kammakileso.
dn31:3.9: idaṃ vatvā sugato, athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
dn31:5.2: chandāgatiṃ gacchanto pāpakammaṃ karoti, dosāgatiṃ gacchanto pāpakammaṃ karoti, mohāgatiṃ gacchanto pāpakammaṃ karoti, bhayāgatiṃ gacchanto pāpakammaṃ karoti.
dn31:5.3: yato kho gahapatiputta ariyasāvako neva chandāgatiṃ gacchati, na dosāgatiṃ gacchati, na mohāgatiṃ gacchati, na bhayāgatiṃ gacchati,
dn31:5.4: imehi catūhi ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karotī’ti.
dn31:5.6: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
dn31:7.1: katamāni cha bhogānaṃ apāyamukhāni na sevati?
dn31:7.2: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānānuyogo kho gahapatiputta bhogānaṃ apāyamukhaṃ. vikālavisikhācariyānuyogo bhogānaṃ apāyamukhaṃ. samajjābhicaraṇaṃ bhogānaṃ apāyamukhaṃ. jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyogo bhogānaṃ apāyamukhaṃ. pāpamittānuyogo bhogānaṃ apāyamukhaṃ. ālassānuyogo bhogānaṃ apāyamukhaṃ.
dn31:8.2: sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, kalahappavaḍḍhanī, rogānaṃ āyatanaṃ, akittisañjananī, kopīnanidaṃsanī paññāya dubbalīkaraṇītveva chaṭṭhaṃ padaṃ bhavati.
dn31:8.3: ime kho gahapatiputta, cha ādīnavā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānānuyoge.
dn31:9.2: attāpi’ssa agutto arakkhito hoti puttadāropi’ssa agutto arakkhito hoti, sāpateyyampi’ssa aguttaṃ arakkhitaṃ hoti, saṅkiyo ca hoti pāpakesu ṭhānesu, abhūtavacanaṃ ca tasmiṃ rūhati, bahūnañca dukkhadhammānaṃ purakkhato hoti.
dn31:9.3: ime kho gahapatiputta, cha ādīnavā vikālavisikhācariyānuyoge.
dn31:10.2: kva naccaṃ, kva gītaṃ, kva vāditaṃ, kva akkhānaṃ, kva pāṇissaraṃ, kva kumbhathūṇanti?
dn31:10.3: ime kho gahapatiputta, cha ādīnavā samajjābhicaraṇe.
dn31:11.2: jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, jito vittamanusocati, sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, sabhāgatassa vacanaṃ na rūhati, mittāmaccānaṃ paribhūto hoti, āvāhavivāhakānaṃ apatthito hoti,
dn31:11.4: ime kho gahapatiputta, cha ādīnavā jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyoge.
dn31:12.2: ye dhuttā, ye soṇḍā, ye pipāsā, ye nekatikā, ye vañcanikā, ye sāhasikā. tyāssa mittā honti, te sahāyā.
dn31:12.3: ime kho gahapatiputta, cha ādīnavā pāpamittānuyoge.
dn31:13.2: atisītanti kammaṃ na karoti, atiuṇhanti kammaṃ na karoti, atisāyanti kammaṃ na karoti, atipāto’ti kammaṃ na karoti, atijāto’smīti kammaṃ na karoti, atidhāto’smīti kammaṃ na karoti.
dn31:13.3: tassa evaṃ kiccāpadesabahulassa viharato anuppannā ceva bhogā nuppajjanti, uppannā ca bhogā parikkhayaṃ gacchanti.
dn31:13.4: ime kho gahapatiputta, cha ādīnavā ālassānuyoge”ti.
dn31:13.6: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
dn31:15.1: cattāro’ me gahapatiputta, amittā mittapatirūpakā veditabbā.
dn31:15.2: aññadatthuharo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, vacīparamo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, anuppiyabhāṇī amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo, apāyasahāyo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:16.1: catūhi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi aññadatthuharo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:16.6: imehi kho gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi aññadatthuharo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:17.1: catūhi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi vacīparamo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:17.2: atītena paṭisantharati anāgatena paṭisantharatiṃ, niratthakena saṅgaṇhāti, paccuppannesu kiccesu byasanaṃ dasseti.
dn31:17.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi vacīparamo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:18.1: catūhi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi anuppiyabhāṇī amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:18.2: pāpakampi’ssa anujānāti, kalyāṇampi’ssa anujānāti, sammukhā’ssa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, parammukhā’ssa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
dn31:18.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi anuppiyabhāṇī amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo.
dn31:19.1: catūhi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi apāyasahāyo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo:
dn31:19.2: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānānuyoge sahāyo hoti, vikālavisikhācariyānuyoge sahāyo hoti, samajjābhicaraṇe sahāyo hoti, jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyoge sahāyo hoti.
dn31:19.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi apāyasahāyo amitto mittapatirūpako veditabbo’ti.
dn31:19.5: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
dn31:21.1: cattāro’ me gahapatiputta, mittā suhadā veditabbā:
dn31:21.2: upakāro mitto suhado veditabbo, samānasukhadukkho mitto suhado veditabbo, atthakkhāyī mitto suhado veditabbo, ānukampako mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:22.1: catūhi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi upakāro mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:22.2: pamattaṃ rakkhati, pamattassa sāpateyyaṃ rakkhati, bhītassa saraṇaṃ hoti, uppanne kiccakaraṇīye taddiguṇaṃ bhogaṃ anuppadeti.
dn31:22.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi upakāro mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:23.1: catūhi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi samānasukhadukkho mitto suhado veditabbo:
dn31:23.2: guyhamassa ācikkhati, guyhamassa parigūhati, āpadāsu na vijahati, jīvitampi’ssa atthāya pariccattaṃ hoti.
dn31:23.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi samānasukhadukkho mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:24.1: catūhi kho pana gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi atthakkhāyī mitto suhado veditabbo:
dn31:24.2: pāpā nivāreti, kalyāṇe niveseti, assutaṃ sāveti, saggassa maggaṃ ācikkhati.
dn31:24.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi atthakkhāyī mitto suhado veditabbo.
dn31:25.1: catūhi kho pana gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi anukampako mitto suhado veditabbo:
dn31:25.2: abhavenassa na nandati, bhavenassa nandati, avaṇṇaṃ bhaṇamānaṃ nivāreti, vaṇṇaṃ bhaṇamānaṃ pasaṃsati.
dn31:25.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, catūhi ṭhānehi anukampako mitto suhado veditabbo”ti.
dn31:25.5: idaṃ vatvā sugato, athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
dn31:26.1: “upakāro ca yo mitto yo ca mitto
dn31:27.3: puratthimā disā mātāpitaro veditabbā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā veditabbā. pacchimā disā puttadārā veditabbā. uttarā disā mittāmaccā veditabbā. heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā veditabbā. uparimā disā samaṇabrāhmaṇā veditabbā.
dn31:28.1: pañcahi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi puttena puratthimā disā mātāpitaro paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:28.2: bhato ne sambharissāmi, kiccaṃ nesaṃ karissāmi, kulavaṃsaṃ ṭhapessāmi, dāyajjaṃ paṭipacchāmi, atha vā pana petānaṃ kālakatānaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ anuppadassāmī”ti.
dn31:28.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi puttena puratthimā disā mātāpitaro paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi puttaṃ anukampanti:
dn31:28.4: pāpā nivārenti, kalyāṇe nivesenti, sippaṃ sikkhāpenti, patirūpena dārena saṃyojenti, samaye dāyajjaṃ niyyātenti.
dn31:28.5: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi puttena puratthimā disā mātāpitaro paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi puttaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:28.6: evamassa esā puratthimā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā.
dn31:29.1: pañcahi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi antevāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:29.2: uṭṭhānena, upaṭṭhānena, sussusāya, pāricariyāya, sakkaccaṃ sippapaṭiggahaṇena.
dn31:29.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhitā, pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsiṃ anukampanti:
dn31:29.4: suvinītaṃ vinenti, suggahitaṃ gāhāpenti, sabbasippasutaṃ samakkhāyino bhavanti, mittāmaccesu paṭiyādenti, disāsu parittānaṃ karonti.
dn31:29.5: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsinā dakkhiṇā disā ācariyā paccupaṭṭhitā, imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi antevāsiṃ anukampanti.
dn31:29.6: evamassa esā dakkhiṇā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā.
dn31:30.1: pañcahi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:30.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhitā, pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikaṃ anukampati:
dn31:30.4: susaṃvihitakammantā ca hoti, susaṃgahitaparijanā ca, anaticārinī ca, sambhataṃ anurakkhati, dakkhā ca hoti, analasā sabbakiccesu.
dn31:30.5: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikena pacchimā disā bhariyā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi sāmikaṃ anukampati.
dn31:30.6: evamassa esā pacchimā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā.
dn31:31.1: pañcahi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi kulaputtena uttarā disā mittāmaccā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:31.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtena uttarā disā mittāmaccā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtaṃ anukampanti:
dn31:31.4: pamattaṃ rakkhanti, pamattassa sāpateyyaṃ rakkhanti, bhītassa saraṇaṃ honti, āpadāsu na vijahanti, aparapajā cassa paṭipūjenti.
dn31:31.5: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtena uttarā disā mittāmaccā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:31.6: evamassa esā uttarā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā.
dn31:32.1: pañcahi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi ayirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:32.2: yathābalaṃ kammantasaṃvidhānena, bhattavetanānuppadānena, gilānupaṭṭhānena, acchariyānaṃ rasānaṃ saṃvibhāgena, samaye vossaggena.
dn31:32.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi ayirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhitā pañcahi ṭhānehi ayirakaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:32.4: pubbuṭṭhāyino ca honti, pacchānipātino ca dinnādāyino ca, sukatakammakarā ca, kittivaṇṇaharā ca.
dn31:32.5: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi ayirakena heṭṭhimā disā dāsakammakarā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi ayirakaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:32.6: evamassa esā heṭṭhimā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā.
dn31:33.1: pañcahi kho gahapatiputta, ṭhānehi kulaputtena uparimā disā samaṇabrāhmaṇā paccupaṭṭhātabbā:
dn31:33.2: mettena kāyakammena mettena vacīkammena, mettena manokammena, anāvaṭadvāratāya, āmisānuppadānena.
dn31:33.3: imehi kho gahapatiputta, pañcahi ṭhānehi kulaputtena uparimā disā samaṇabrāhmaṇā paccupaṭṭhitā chahi ṭhānehi kulaputtaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:33.4: pāpā nivārenti, kalyāṇe nivesenti, kalyāṇena manasā anukampanti, assutaṃ sāventi, sutaṃ pariyodapenti, saggassa maggaṃ ācikkhanti.
dn31:33.5: imehi kho gahapatiputta, chahi ṭhānehi kulaputtena uparimā disā samaṇabrāhmaṇā paccupaṭṭhitā imehi chahi ṭhānehi kulaputtaṃ anukampanti.
dn31:33.6: evamassa esā uparimā disā paṭicchannā hoti khemā appaṭibhayā”ti.
dn31:33.8: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
dn31:35.1: evaṃ vutte sigālako gahapatiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn31:35.3: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti. evameva bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn31:35.4: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca bhikkhusaṃghañca.
dn31:35.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
